sentences.text:
Claims Tribunal, MACT Srinagar ought to have reserved right to pay and recover in its favour to be invoked against the registered owner/s of the offending vehicle who are the respondents No. 2A and 2.
5.

This Court would have surely lend its consideration to this plea of the appellant-insurance company provided the appellant at the evidence stage of the claim petition would have come up with a cross examination to prove the fact that the offending vehicle on the date of accident being on a non-permit route being was being plied and used for carrying of the passengers against the very breach of 6.

The mere fact that the accident occurred on a non-permit route involving the offending vehicle cannot lead to an inference of fact that the offending vehicle was in use for commercial purpose/business purpose by the registered owner/s of the offending vehicle and, therefore, the challenge being thrown to the award by the appellant- insurance company is more on imaginary side rather than based upon evidence side and, as such, the appeal cannot succeed to upset the award which has earned only Rs. 1,20,000/- as compensation in favour of the respondent No.3 for the fracture injury of shaft of right humour.
7.

Learned counsel for the appellant-insurance company vehemently submits that the heads of compensation pressed into service by the MACT, Srinagar are on the higher side, as against his claim for compensation of Rs. 84,40,000/- the respondent No. 3 has been paid Rs. 60,000/- on account of his medical treatment, Rs. 40,000/- as loss of future earning and Rs. 20,000/- for pain,
suffering and trauma.
8.

The very fact that the MACT, Srinagar is already on the conservative side of compensation assessed shall be a good enough reason for the appellant-United India Insurance Company Ltd. to feel having been let off with very token like compensation in favour of the respondent No.3 so as to feel bothered to stretch this appeal to any further just for adding years of pendency to it as has already taken place more than ten years for this adjudication to take place.
9. The appeal is accordingly, dismissed.
10. Compensation amount, if any, deposited by the appellant-insurance company and lying with this Court shall be disbursed to the respondent No.3 by the Registrar Judicial Srinagar.

(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE SRINAGAR 12.11.2024 "Abdul Rashid"
